name: compromised
description: Root scripts that run the Python service (api/) and the web app (web/) together.

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'pnpm db:migrate && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"'
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory api python -m compromised.storage migrate
scripts.worker:once: dotenv -e .env -- uv run --directory api python -m compromised.worker --once
